TSV Tracker Line — 9-Column Batch Output Format
Dual-Track Candidate Pattern
nodes.rationale: Addresses the case where a candidate has two primary archetypes (e.g., engineer + instructor). Single-track config flattens one side. Dual-track requires two fit:primary entries, layered or sectioned CV structure, separate comp ranges per track, and archetype-aware evaluation that detects which track the JD targets.

nodes.label: User Layer — Never Auto-Updated Personalization Files
Unicode Normalization — ATS Compatibility Pass
nodes.rationale: Em-dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis, zero-width spaces, and non-breaking spaces cause parsing errors or display issues in ATS systems and legacy parsers. generate-pdf.mjs applies a normalization pass to convert these to ASCII-safe equivalents.
